subject: science
concept: Understanding that all matter is made of tiny particles too small to see
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Properties of Matter) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student observes sugar dissolving in water and discusses where the sugar particles went
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a zoomed-in particle diagram to the correct state of matter
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, why matter looks solid/smooth even though it's made of particles

misconception_flags: believes dissolved sugar has disappeared entirely rather than broken into invisible particles

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
